$comment: Local weather and golden hour. The host fetches the current WMO weather_code for the fixed location below and passes the condition to the core.
No geolocation and nothing about the player is ever sent: only these coordinates and the request fields.
conditions are in core order (set_weather 0, 1, 2). wmo lists inclusive weather_code ranges per condition; any code not listed is the default condition.
Sunset is a build-time table (tools/sunset.py, NOAA algorithm) for the fixed location. Golden hour runs from before_minutes ahead of sunset to after_minutes past it.
visual colours are palette indices drawn in code as a stand-in until art: window and balcony are alpha overlays, streak is the rain line.
visual.<condition>.outside mixes the background around the house toward that colour; at night it is scaled down to 40%.
Local-clock day and night. Colours are palette indices (null = the home's own background colour).
Phases start at their time and run until the next start (the last wraps past midnight); neighbours cross-fade over blend_minutes centred on the boundary.
window picks the sky variant drawn in glass; balcony and room are alpha overlays; lamps is the glow strength 0-1.
